name: Forgotten: 128
source:
In the year 2023, there was a zombie outbreak. While people were losing hope,  an unknown race came to their aid in exchange for something.

You wake up in a garden with some memory lost, and must join in the search for your memories along with the "narrator"

[from [url=https://zieelane.itch.io/forgotten]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
2023年，丧尸疫情爆发。人们逐渐失去希望时，一个未知种族前来援助，却要求某种东西作为交换。

你在一座花园醒来，失去了一部分记忆，必须与“叙述者”一起，踏上寻找记忆的旅程。

[摘自[url=https://zieelane.itch.io/forgotten]itch.io[/url]]
